recommendation: Keep the audit commit as-is. Do not restore the superseded profile parameter for FHIR-5787; future terminology work should target the current $expand parameters or ValueSet.expansion property model if more behavior is needed.
issue_request: FHIR-5787 was a Published Vocab change request asking whether ValueSet expansions needed active/inactive support and support for other code system properties. Its accepted resolution was to document inactive-code inclusion as a proper use for the $expand profile parameter rather than add a separate flag at that time.
initial_application: Git-svn commit 347cc6c43e2bf9aa38c0dd11d80caa8aacfee646 applied the issue by updating the old valueset spreadsheet entry for expand.profile so known uses included whether to include inactive concepts.
additional_context: FHIR-5788 added the $expand profile parameter used by the FHIR-5787 resolution. Later Published Vocab issues FHIR-16337 and FHIR-16490 led to removal of ExpansionProfile/profile guidance in commit 0cf4c0c96d333dbe2a5b7a5d158f7e59db4c4b5b and to documentation that all parameters affecting $expand should be recorded with the expansion. Current ValueSet source now has explicit activeOnly and property $expand parameters, ValueSet.expansion.parameter metadata, ValueSet.expansion.contains.inactive, and ValueSet.expansion.contains.property.
reconciliation: Published an empty no-change audit commit. Reintroducing $expand.profile would conflict with later terminology work; current build-scope source conveys the needed behavior directly.
